# Agent Instructions
This documentation is published with GitBook. Both humans and AI agents can read, navigate, and reason over it.

## Querying This Documentation
Query any docs page dynamically by appending `?ask=<question>` to its `.md` URL:
```
GET https://docs.tradersyard.com/traderchallenge/faqs.md?ask=Does TradersYard allow copy trading?
```
The response contains a direct answer plus relevant excerpts and sources.
